title: CanonicalDoc
description: Normalized representation of an ingested source document. Single source of truth — generate TS types (shared/ts) and pydantic models (shared/py) from this file; never hand-edit the generated code.

failed_figure_storage_ids.description: Figure ids whose storage (during /ingest) failed -- still captioned, but not viewable/attachable later. Never populated by /level; ado_verification_failed's own WarningKind precedent applies -- the orchestrator, not ingestion, turns a non-empty list here into its own synthesized WarningRecord.

vision_active.description: Whether /ingest actually opened the vision-LLM gate for this document (False for BASELINE, a preview call, or no vision model configured). Round-tripped from /ingest's response through /level's own `doc` request body -- consumed there to emit a single tree-level WarningKind.vision_captioning_disabled warning when False and figures is non-empty.

page_end.description: Last page this ref's content covers. Null means same as page, or unknown.

page_provenance.description: Null = real pagination from the file itself. 'rendered' = derived via a re-render (e.g. docx->PDF for pagination). 'interpolated' = bracketed between anchors, not directly matched.

section_path.description: Root-first heading/section labels for the section this ref was parsed from. Empty when no heading ancestry applies.

background_color.description: Normalized #rrggbb, contrast-adapted for dual light/dark theme safety. 'No fill' (auto/white/near-white) is normalized to null, not a literal white.

ocr_recovered.description: Set when this cell's text could not be extracted directly and was recovered via OCR on a rendered crop -- see TableCell.ocr_recovered's own docstring in canonical/model.py.

nested_table_dropped.description: Set when this cell's own DOCX markup contains a nested table whose content could not be represented in the canonical model and was dropped -- see TableCell.nested_table_dropped's own docstring in canonical/model.py.

cells.description: Row-major grid. null at a position means it's SPANNED (absorbed by a preceding cell's colspan/rowspan) -- render no <td> there. A real TableCell with text:"" at a position is a genuine GAP (e.g. an empty PDF-detected cell) -- render an empty <td>. Every row has the same length (validated) -- a merge/gridBefore/gridAfter mismatch is a bug, not a valid shape.

column_widths.description: Fractions of table width (never source units like twips/EMU/chars/points) -- must sum to ~1.0 when present.

border_style.description: Deliberately coarse -- not a full per-side border spec.

style_provenance.description: Null = read from explicit source markup. 'heuristic' = geometrically/heuristically inferred (PDF only). Mirrors SourceRef.page_provenance's precedent.

name.description: The author's own short title for this figure, parsed from a 'Figure N: Title' caption line in the source document itself, or an LLM-generated short title when the document provides no caption line of its own. Distinct from `caption` (the vision model's prose description): `name` is a short noun phrase meant for display (UI label, ADO attachment filename).

caption_status.description: Why `caption` is null, when it is. 'insignificant': the vision model judged the figure decorative/non-technical. 'vision_failed': the vision call itself errored/timed out or returned an unparseable response. Null both when a real caption was produced AND when vision never ran for this figure at all (disabled for the whole run, or BASELINE mode) -- the latter is deliberately not distinguished here; see CanonicalDoc.vision_active and WarningKind.vision_captioning_disabled for that case instead.
